- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:631-644 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Prune verifies that the oldest digest is unchanged, then closes duplicate digests without verifying their bodies are unchanged.
  WHY: A park operation that selected a duplicate before the oldest digest became visible can update that duplicate after prune reads it. Prune then closes the duplicate without merging the new entry. The item is omitted from the returned parked-item list and can be judged and parked again, producing a duplicate alert.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:358-361; 112-120 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failed Telegram send is ignored, and the alert is only attempted when the digest helper returns `newly_parked=true`.
  WHY: If the first CRITICAL send fails, the digest entry remains. A later park sees that entry and returns `newly_parked=false`, so the alert is never retried and the parked item receives no CRITICAL notification.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
